snippet.title: Aerial_Knight's DropShot: with a Vengeance Update Trailer
snippet.description: Aerial Knight’s DropShot: With a Vengeance is a massive FREE content update featuring new character skins, updated cutscenes, enhanced player movement, improved targeting, expanded settings, new quick-time events, improved level progression, updated environment art, performance upgrades, localization for 7 new languages, new achievements, and the all-new RUSH MODE challenge, along with numerous gameplay improvements and bug fixes based on player feedback.
